builtin-commands-rows The builtin_commands rows pin the receipt, the record, and the routes of a typed command.
child-report-segment A child report to a busy parent reaches the model as the tasks segment.
drain-two-messages A drain that holds a prompt and a report gives two messages.
external-items-complete An item of a third-party harness becomes an item.completed record.
goal-evaluator-prompt The goal evaluator prompt has a form for met, not_met, and impossible.
goal-tool-wording The goal tool text and errors carry the engine: prefix.
later-send-not-refused A send to a child after a tree interrupt is not refused.
no-box-global-journal No box-global events journal exists; each session has one log.
no-deferred-goal The runtime has no deferred or parked goal; SetGoal on a busy session starts nothing.
no-status-routes No wait, request, session status, or event tip route exists.
one-page-route A session has one page route and one event cursor; no bootstrap form exists.
status-line-follows The base prompt says that the process status follows the system prompt.
task-notice-is-input A task notification is an input with source child.
task-tool-wording The task tool has the actions spawn, cancel, status, send, and log.
workspace-changes-rows The git_changes rows pin GET /workspace/changes and its error body.
mcp-retry-held The background retry of the serve binary can connect a server before the connect action of the row, so only the runtime host, which holds the retry, runs the row.
child-report-held The report of a child settles in its parent in a goroutine, so only the runtime host, which holds that report with the tree seam, places a send between the end of the child turn and the report.
